Frequently Asked Questions

Is my Vercel API token safe?

Yes! Your API token is stored locally in your browser's localStorage and is never transmitted to any external servers. All API calls are made directly from your browser to Vercel's API.

Can I recover deleted projects?

No, deletions are permanent and cannot be undone. Always double-check your selections before confirming any delete operations.

Is this tool free to use?

Yes, Vercel Bulk Manager is completely free to use with no hidden costs or limitations.

How do I get a Vercel API token?

Visit your Vercel account settings at vercel.com/account/tokens to create a new API token. Make sure to give it the necessary permissions.

I have a feature request. Where can I submit it?

We'd love to hear your ideas! Please open an issue on our GitHub repository with the "enhancement" label.
